---
name: Bug report
about: Record a reproducible source behavior defect
labels: bug
---

## Problem

Describe the actual result and its impact. Search existing open and closed issues first.

## Reproduction and evidence

Include the smallest script or host call, source revision, profile and relevant limits.
For language behavior, include the pinned Luau 0.709 result and how it was obtained.
Keep credentials, infrastructure details and sensitive client data in rustia-ops.

## Expected behavior and authority

Link the design contract, conformance row or pinned upstream test.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Add a regression that reproduces the defect and verifies the correction.
- [ ] Update affected design, conformance and code maps with the implementation.
- [ ] Independent review and applicable preflight/CI pass; verify the merged result.

## Related work

Link existing issues or PRs. Record branch/PR and current progress when work begins.
